models.name: LegalConsiderations

modules.label: Doc → Text
modules.note: Parse the contract and annotate its governing purpose.

modules.label: Extract Atomic Rules
modules.prompt: Extract the 6 most important atomic, independently verifiable legal rules from the document. For each rule, give a stable rule_id (R-01, R-02, …), a concise plain-language description, the verbatim source quote it came from, and a 1-5 severity. Return at most 6 rules.

modules.label: Sort Rules by Severity
modules.note: Custom TS function — deterministic glue step, no LLM cost.

modules.label: Assess Compliance
modules.note: Evaluate the company against every rule.
modules.prompt: Given the company data and the extracted legal requirements, produce one concise assessment per rule: a short summary, the rule_id, a compliant verdict, a brief rationale, and the estimated USD liability exposure if non-compliant.

models.name: SourceDocument
models.description: Raw JSON file annotated with its purpose.

models.name: Address
models.description: Nested address built from dotted target fields.

fields.name: city
fields.description: City, null when the legacy record had none

models.name: MigratedUser
models.description: One record in the new schema, produced purely from the mapping spec.

fields.name: plan
fields.description: Defaulted when absent in legacy data

modules.label: Parse JSON Records
modules.note: Custom TS function — raw JSON text → typed legacy records, no LLM cost.

modules.label: Apply Field Mapping
modules.note: Driven entirely by the mapping spec: transform registry, dotted targets nest, missing source → default else null, unmapped legacy fields dropped.
